topic: Write an argumentative letter about learning another foreign language(就再开一门外语写议论性书信)
title_en: Is English the Only Foreign Language Worth Learning?
genre: 议论文 / 劝说信(argumentative letter with claim and counterclaim)
source: 上外版选择性必修二 Unit 2 Writing:写一封劝说信,用 claim 与 counterclaim 论证高中是否应开设英语之外的外语课。
prompt_cn: 假设你是陈凯,你校只教英语一门外语。你希望学校能再开设一门法语课。请用英语给校长写一封约100–120词的劝说信,内容包括:① 明确提出你的主张(claim):高中生应有机会学习英语以外的语言;② 先承认对方可能的反方观点(counterclaim),再加以反驳;③ 给出一两条具体理由(如能与更多人交流、打开新世界);④ 礼貌地提出请求。注意:用上主语从句/表语从句让说理更清楚。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Chen Kai, and your school teaches only English as a foreign language. Write a letter (about 100–120 words) to your headmaster to persuade him to offer a French course. Include: 1) a clear claim that students should be able to learn languages other than English; 2) a likely counterclaim, which you then answer; 3) one or two concrete reasons; 4) a polite request. Try to use subject or predicative clauses to make your argument clear.
points: 明确主张(I strongly believe that students should …)
承认并反驳反方观点(It is true that … However, …)
给出具体理由(What a new language offers is …)
礼貌请求(I would be grateful if the school could …)
model_essay:
Dear Headmaster,

I am writing to ask the school to offer a French course. I strongly believe that high school students should be able to learn a language other than English.

It is true that English is already used in business, science and travel around the world. However, this does not mean that one language is enough. What a new language really offers is a fresh way of seeing the world and a chance to reach millions more people. The truth is that every language we learn quietly changes how we think.

Many of my classmates feel the same way. I would be grateful if the school could consider opening a French class.

Yours sincerely,
Chen Kai
model_translation:
尊敬的校长:

我写信是想请学校开设一门法语课。我坚信高中生应当有机会学习英语之外的语言。

诚然,英语在全球的商业、科学和旅行中已被广泛使用。然而,这并不意味着一门语言就足够了。一门新语言真正带来的,是看待世界的全新方式,以及接触数百万更多人的机会。事实是,我们所学的每一门语言都在悄悄改变我们的思维。

我的许多同学也有同感。如果学校能考虑开设一个法语班,我将不胜感激。

此致
陈凯

rubric.criteria: 要素齐全:明确主张 / 承认并反驳反方观点 / 具体理由 / 礼貌请求
claim–counterclaim 逻辑清晰、过渡自然、书信格式正确、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、主语/表语从句运用得当、语法基本无误

反方+反驳 It is true that … However, this does not mean that …

error_pairs.wrong: I believe that students should to learn French.
error_pairs.correct: I believe that students should learn French.
error_pairs.note: 情态动词 should 后接动词原形,不加 to。

error_pairs.wrong: The truth is what every language changes our thinking.
error_pairs.correct: The truth is that every language changes our thinking.
error_pairs.note: 表语从句陈述事实、从句完整,用 that 不用 what。

error_pairs.wrong: What a new language offers are a new way of thinking.
error_pairs.correct: What a new language offers is a new way of thinking.
error_pairs.note: What 引导的主语从句作主语视为单数,谓语用 is。
